Commit b1a1c99ab52b687cf950d62c88bc2fa316b41663
https://github.com/doitsujin/dxvk

Local patches: g3vr-ffr-v1.patch, then g3vr-d3d9-stable-interop.patch.
The latter pins only image addresses exported through D3D9 Vulkan interop,
using DXVK's existing stableGpuAddress mechanism. Defrag remains enabled for
other eligible resources; FFR ABI remains version 1.
